parameters.query:
SELECT
  trim(both FROM bc.currency_code::text) AS currency_code,
  cr.connector_key,
  cr.active AS connector_active,
  cr.contract_version
FROM governance.business_config bc
JOIN governance.connector_registry cr
  ON cr.connector_key = 'rest_ingestion_api'
ORDER BY bc.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  deal_id,
  connector_key,
  source_record_id,
  deal_name,
  amount,
  trim(both FROM currency_code::text) AS currency_code,
  stage_name,
  stage_category,
  sales_rep,
  lead_source,
  created_at,
  expected_close_date,
  closed_at,
  source_updated_at,
  contract_version,
  ingested_at
FROM reporting.deals
WHERE connector_key = $1
  AND source_record_id = $2
LIMIT 1;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('VAL | Normalize REST Deal').item.json.connector_key, $('VAL | Normalize REST Deal').item.json.source_record_id ] }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO audit.agent_events (
  event_id,
  request_id,
  correlation_id,
  event_type,
  stage,
  actor,
  payload
)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,'deal_ingested','stage4','n8n_rest_connector',$4::jsonb);
